args.title: In the int() helper, Number.parseInt(raw, 10) silently parses strings li
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

In the int() helper, Number.parseInt(raw, 10) silently parses strings like "12h" or "1h" as 12 or 1 because parseInt stops at the first non-digit instead of failing; it should validate that the whole string is a valid integer (e.g. using a regex or Number.isInteger(Number(raw))) and throw for any trailing non-numeric characters so misconfigured TTL values like TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES=12h fail fast at startup instead of being silently truncated.

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/config.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
src/config.ts's int(name, fallback) does `const value = Number.parseInt(raw, 10); if (Number.isNaN(value)) throw ...` which only rejects completely non-numeric strings; "12h" parses to 12 and "1h" parses to 1, matching the reported symptom that TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES=12h behaves as 12 and the service starts without complaint, and RESET_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES=1h behaves as 1.

file: src/i18n/index.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
pickLocale in src/i18n/index.ts splits the header on commas and returns the first part whose language code is in LOCALES, never reading the ';q=' weight, so 'en;q=0.3, fr-FR;q=0.9' resolves to 'en' instead of 'fr'. This function is used by src/api/errors.ts and src/api/uploads.ts to localize upload error responses, matching the reported behaviour.
